thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU memory pressure detected in pool-west2a (kvcache growth). samples: nvml.OOM(alloc=2.3GiB) x12 in 3m. PagerDuty: PDR-4332 fired.

alice_oncall: acked — I'm on it. Pulling dashboards now.

bob_sre: saw the spike in kvcache evictions ~10:42 UTC. Likely sustained prefetch from a heavy batch job.

carla_runtime: thanks — routing shows most traffic hitting model: llama-13b-v2 quantized. Sequence len distribution spiked. Can we divert new sessions to fallback-variant? @alice_oncall

alice_oncall: @carla_runtime initiate fallback routing for west2a -> warm pool (llama-13b-v2-compact) — set 10s window. also reduce max_batch_size for the pool to 4.

carla_runtime: running commands: 
```
redwoodctl pools route --from=pool-west2a --to=pool-west2a-compact --models=llama-13b-v2 --duration=10s
redwoodctl pool config set pool-west2a max_batch_size=4
```

bob_sre: started draining the top offenders: node-gpu-07 had 92% mem used. Issuing drain and restart on that node.

alice_oncall: @dave_support do we have any customer-impact alerts? I see slightly elevated 5xx for a small subset of dedicated customers in west2a.

dave_support: I notified two customers on dedicated west2a (ACME, FinchLabs) — their requests saw 5-10% latency spikes and a handful of timeouts. they're monitoring. no critical SLA breaches yet.

erin_pm: are we confident fallback keeps quality acceptable? we should log eval flag for potential regression (notify customers later).

carla_runtime: fallback running; kvcache hitrate dropping which is expected. memory stabilized on node-gpu-07 after restart, evictions tapering.

bob_sre: manual intervention: killed rogue prefetch job on node-gpu-03 (pid 14321). patch applied to limit prefetch concurrency in the autoscaler.

alice_oncall: monitoring for 15m. setting incident status -> investigating. adding runbook tag: kvcache-prefetch.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PDR-4332 acknowledged by alice_oncall.

alice_oncall: 10m check: memory pressure trending down, aggregate 99p latency back to baseline for most routes. still small error tail for some dedicated instances; support is on it.

carla_runtime: rolling a soft limit patch to prefetch controller to enforce max_prefetch=2 per model per node. command: `kubectl apply -f prefetch-patch.yaml`

bob_sre: nodes healthy, no further OOMs in last 6m.

dave_support: updated customers: ACME acknowledged mitigation, FinchLabs asked for postmortem.

alice_oncall: resolving pager for now. final steps: leave fallback routing for 5m ramp-down then revert; create postmortem draft and include prompt sets and model variant metrics.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PDR-4332 resolved by alice_oncall.

alice_oncall: Thanks team. Follow-ups: postmortem + add a guard to autoscaler config to avoid concurrent prefetches >2. assigning to @erin_pm and @bob_sre. :thumbsup:
